notes.title: Quantum Gravity Update is Here!

Hello everybody!

Exciting news awaits – the Quantum Gravity update is now live for PC! We can't wait for you to experience the latest enhancements and innovations. 

[previewyoutube=gHxEVjh1gyg;full][/previewyoutube]
Your feedback is immensely valuable, so please take a moment to dive in, give it a try, and share your thoughts by leaving a review on Steam. Your input means the world to us!

That's all for now!
Keep an eye out for more updates and news coming your way :)

Best regards,

Ed, Doug, and Lucas
@BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Devlog #7: More About Upcoming Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thank you for your interest and support in Nova Lands! We really appreciate that and now are working hard on the upcoming content expansion. And we have something interesting to share with you! Let’s check it out :)

[h3]New Additions Await![/h3]

In this expansion, we're introducing another two new buildings:

[b]The Driller[/b]: Say goodbye to the laborious task of manually extracting minerals from the soil! The Driller is here to streamline the process and supercharge your resource gathering efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/7c38997805fe8be452077f8f4c8e862e5c3a1b3f.png[/img]

[b]The Teleporter[/b]: Tired of trekking across all the islands? Create teleportation points that allow you to travel swiftly to any location you desire. It's all about simplicity and efficiency :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/4c45b688103698f928ac2c89472175a03a61cc6f.png[/img]

[h3]Customize Your Playstyle[/h3]

We get it, everyone's got their quirks. That's why we're introducing the [b]Item Collector Filter[/b]. It's your ticket to deciding what gets [b]picked up automatically[/b] and what [b]gets left behind[/b]. Your adventure, your rules!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/d9fd8cba6752d045762e66d0775f29b0aa71f5c2.png[/img]

[h3]Discover the Unknown[/h3]

While we can't unveil all the secrets just yet, we're thrilled to offer a sneak peek of a brand-new island. Prepare to explore uncharted territories, make new friends, uncover fresh resources, and encounter exotic flora and fauna. The mysteries of this island are waiting to be unveiled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/f679abf66bac198f62c10d9038b4ffd532c52017.png[/img]

Keep your eyes peeled for more updates by following Nova Lands on our Steam page and across our social media channels:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NovaLandsGame/]Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/BEHEMUTT]Twitter[/url]
[/list]
Thank you for your attention and have a great day!
See you in Nova Lands :)

Ed, Doug, and Lucas @BEHEMUTT

notes.title: Nova Lands release in June!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

First of all, we wanted to thank you for all the support and patience during the development. It’s been such a ride for our 2 person studio (now 3!). We worked a lot, learned a lot, and we’re very happy and proud of the end result.

[b]So we wanted to announce that the game is (finally) coming out in June![/b]

The exact date will be revealed soon in a brand-new trailer. Also, the game is coming out in full, so no Early Access.

Thank you for playing the demo!
Thank you for joining the Discord community!
Thank you for playing the closed beta!
Thank you for playing Emilia’s Mission prologue and giving it such a high review rate!
Thank you for reporting bugs and sending suggestions!

This launch is a really big deal for us, so thank you for being part of this, and from the bottom of our hearts we hope you love it :)

Ed, Doug, and Lucas @ BEHEMUTT

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/2eb1232a38cdb62a495ab95eda7dab96d48d1854.gif[/img]
Move whole stacks of items from one island to any deposit in any other island.
It's a complete game-changer, and we love it! 

[h2]Transporter Arm[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/bb38a25a362360f4dd393ffa0dd1796afb7f66af.gif[/img]
A cool new visual change I'm excited about is the outdated Transporter Container is now called Transporter Arm. Also, one side of the island can now have 8 of them! 

[h2]Refreshed skill-tree[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/87ec10f3b9e880fd822d9b9c7209ffdb0a62623f.png[/img]
A new skill-tree screen with all the brand new icons!

[h2]Button Remapping[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/d9e9c2a13c9c43884d2700cbfdf8c8e4b26769e9.png[/img]
Change the buttons of the game on keyboard & mouse or controller.

[h2]Tunasa - New boss[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/2a65d66812784b3bc1e8a4a89f6f8f0cb8dae89e.gif[/img]
The third of the big three. Tunasa, the flying fish.
Look at that cutie.

[h2]The brand new Challenges Screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/22a1a8e4b46059af90e1cbcdfe26c9014c232c9f.png[/img]
A big list of stuff to do and be rewarded for. 

Thanks for your patience, we hope you love it!
-Ed and Douglas

notes.title: The Supercomputer Update
notes.notes:
We're running a Closed Alpha on Steam!
The game has just been updated and we're sending alpha keys for players interested in testing the game.

How to join the Closed Alpha?
Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/EAgPVJNsdZ]DISCORD[/url] and fill out the form on the [b]#steam-alpha-access[/b] channel.

Come hang with us, ask questions and leave suggestions!
[url=https://discord.gg/EAgPVJNsdZ][img]https://i.imgur.com/FHrGkGB.png[/img][/url]

About the update:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5uA2nfu.png[/img]

[h2]The Collection Screen[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RvFGsZH.png[/img]
This screen is meant to give you an overall of your progress in the game.

Also, notice 2 new features in the game: Badges and Relics. Badges are kinda like trophies for achieving big milestones in the game. Relics are rewards for challenges that grant you a special perk. 

[h2]Advanced Farms[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GS3iNHY.gif[/img]
A game-changer and the biggest building yet!
They work like simple farm plots but they have their own extractor and watering system. You provide the seeds, water, and fertilizers. They do the work. Automatized agriculture to step up production!

[h2]Oxygen Link[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MkD5chg.png[/img]
A most requested building, the Oxygen Link. Take oxygen from the Oxygenator to adjacent islands. Finally!

[h2]Production Expansion[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e0xsOsd.png[/img]
The main focus of this update is expanding production and technology. That means more items, more researches, more buildings, more recipes. 

The Assembler building has a new visual (pic). Also, it is now a bit smaller and occupies the same area as a Refinery or an Advanced Furnace.


Once again thanks for sticking with us.

We hope you love it!
